label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
To: #general
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marco,

I just got Lupe’s note about Desert Palms. Yvette has a tenant in 9B who lost her key and wants three copies today, and I’ve got nothing to cut from because there is not one Desert Palms code in the sheet. On top of that, your black pinning tray with pins in it is sitting on the counter in their leasing office. That’s my tray.

This is the same deal as Kessler in September. I told you then. I put it out to everybody in August: every rekey, every master job, address, unit, bitting code, in the code sheet the same day before you leave the van. That was not optional. It still isn’t. I’m not firing you — you’re good with your hands and I want you on the van — but this cannot keep happening. When the code isn’t in the sheet, the next person is stuck, and this time it’s Yvette and a tenant.

You go back out to Desert Palms today. Decode 9B at least so we can cut her keys. If you can get all 14 units decoded while you’re there, do it. Then every one of those codes goes in the sheet before you leave that property — address, unit, code, same day. And bring my pinning tray back with you. I want it back in the shop, not on Yvette’s counter.

I don’t want excuses on this. I want it done today. If something got in the way Saturday, tell me, but the codes still have to get logged. This is the second time we’ve had this conversation and I’m not going to have it again.

Ray
